decisions.briefing: Markets drifted modestly higher today (NASDAQ +0.4%, S&P 500 +0.7%) without a clear risk-on signal. With only $289.29 in cash — below the $500 threshold needed to responsibly open a new position — we're holding all 7 existing positions and waiting for a genuine risk-on setup before deploying into open slots.

market_education.summary_en: Both major indices posted small gains today, with the S&P 500 outpacing the NASDAQ, consistent with a broad, low-conviction drift higher rather than any single catalyst-driven move. No major economic data or company-specific headlines were flagged as market movers today. This kind of quiet, mixed-magnitude session often reflects investors digesting recent moves rather than reacting to new information.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日美股兩大指數溫和收高，標普500的升幅(+0.7%)略勝納指(+0.4%)，屬於缺乏明確催化因素的普遍性小幅上揚。今日並未有重大經濟數據或個股新聞成為市場焦點。這種波幅溫和、漲跌不一的交易日，往往反映投資者在消化近期走勢，而非對新消息作出反應。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: "Dry powder" refers to cash kept on the sidelines, ready to invest once a clearly favorable opportunity appears. Today our cash balance was below the $500 threshold needed to safely size a new position, so rather than forcing a trade on a neutral day, we're holding that cash in reserve for a stronger risk-on signal.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）是指投資者保留在場邊、等待明確有利時機才動用的現金。今日我們的現金餘額低於500美元的安全建倉門檻，與其在市況中性的一天勉強交易，不如保留現金，等待更強的風險偏好訊號出現。
